answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a staked attestation web: each new agent locks real collateral and is vouched for by already-staked peers, forming a thread of trust an attacker cannot fabricate at scale. Honest work pays nectar only to identities whose stake backs them, and any node caught vouching for fakes gets slashed. To field thousands of fakes, an attacker must post thousands of independent bonds and recruit genuine vouchers, so each extra identity costs capital that can be burned on detection, making the bridge from one account to an army costly.
